decisions.reason: The position covers pipeline surveying, georeferencing, and documentation only.
The position pays for hourly labour and associated costs, not for a new physical product.
The position supplies a new pre-insulated pipe with integrated leak-detection wiring.

items.description: Direct-buried pipe with integrated copper moisture-detection wiring; fittings and joints are paid separately.
